name: Dyn_World_IntegrateVelocities
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. Outlined block of 00C5BB30 with the world in ESI and dt on the stack (no clean prologue; Ghidra shows unaff_ESI), body 00C41550-00C41AC8. First phase of one Dyn substep: walks the world body list at world+204h (sentinel world+208h, next at body+84h) and, for each body whose B+50h bit 4 is clear, does v += (M+50h)*dt*force (M+50h is the INVERSE mass), adds world gravity (world+04h..+0Ch) unless B+50h bit 2 is set, applies linear damping max(0,1-M[+B8h]*dt), rebuilds the world inverse inertia M+60h..+80h as sum_k Ik*(row_k (x) row_k) from M+54h..+5Ch and the body rows, does w += Iw^-1 * torque * dt, applies angular damping M+BCh, and finally, when the byte at M+B4h is set, rebuilds Iw^-1 keeping only the row-1 term (literal 0.0f multiplies on rows 0 and 2). docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md

name: Dyn_World_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. world* __cdecl(world*, const DynWorldDescriptor*), body 00C41AD0..00C420DB; 00C42119 pushes the descriptor and 00C4211A the world. Its fifteen copies at 00C41AF2..00C41B4A are the whole of the descriptor's effect: world+00h=desc+00h the fixed substep (0.05f in the shipped game), +04h..+0Ch=desc+04h..+0Ch gravity (0,-10,0), +10h=desc+20h, +14h=desc+28h, +18h=desc+2Ch, +1Ch=desc+30h, +20h=desc+34h, +28h=desc+3Ch, +34h=desc+10h the int substep budget (1), +38h=desc+24h (10), +3Ch=desc+14h and +40h=desc+18h the sleep speed thresholds (both 0.0f), +44h=desc+1Ch the sleep countdown reload (20). The rest of the body builds the pools, the broad phase and the task lists and was not read. docs/DYN_WORLD_SETTINGS.md.

name: Dyn_Engine_CreateWorld
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. world* __thiscall(engine, const DynWorldDescriptor*), RET 4, body 00C420E0..00C421A3, SEH frame 00CC81B6. operator_new(0x48C) at 00C420F8, Dyn_World_Construct 00C41AD0 at 00C4211B, then the world is appended to the engine's vector at engine+00h/+04h/+08h. Its only caller is the game constructor 004DDB90 at 004DE1D3, with the engine from game+14h in ECX and a 40h-byte stack descriptor at ESP+1Ch; the returned world is stored at game+18h by 004DE1DB, which is the pointer 00875E06 loads each fixed step. docs/DYN_WORLD_SETTINGS.md.

name: Dyn_Body_InitFromDescriptor
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void(body in EAX, const DynBodyDescriptor* in EDX), RET 0, body 00C43CA0..00C43E9C; the registers are set by its only caller at 00C5D8B5/00C5D8B7. The producer of every body and motion-state field, so it settles the 84h-byte descriptor layout: desc+00h -> M+B4h (00C43CC7), +04h -> M+50h as 1/mass with no zero guard (00C43DA1), +08h..+10h -> M+54h..+5Ch as 1/x or 0 when x<=0 (00C43E01..00C43E0A), +14h..+43h the 3x4 transform -> B+08h (00C43E4D) and M+84h (00C43CDE), +44h -> M+00h, +50h -> M+0Ch, +5Ch -> B+50h (00C43CB8), +60h -> M+B8h (00C43D79), +64h -> M+BCh (00C43D85), +68h -> M+18h, +6Ch -> M+1Ch, +70h -> B+68h, +74h -> B+6Ch. Also seeds B+54h with 14h at 00C43E57. docs/SHIP_HULL_BODY.md.
